material.description: The page polls /site/version and reloads itself once when its own script changes, keeping the server session and reporting data-page-version. Landed in 8afb9e9 (static_files.rs version route, lib.rs route, main.js watchPage, ci.yml page-self-reload).
material.resolution: The page polls /site/version and reloads itself once when its own script changes, keeping the server session. Caveats: once-only check compares the stamp after 3 s; the stamp cache keys on mtime and length.
material.subject: Browser reloads its own code on change, keeping the session
material.witness: check-runs for 7db475c: 47 success; page-self-reload job success
